IBN ai.-MU^AFFA' , Abu ',Amr (afterwards 
I AbD Muhammad), the “son of the cripple”, an 
Arab author of Persian origin, whose real name 
was Rozbih son of Dadoye ; his father, a native 
of Djur (Firuz
description.tr: [İBN EL-MUKAFFA] İBN EL-MUKAFFA, Ebû Amr (sonradan Abd Muhammed), "topalın oğlu", Fars asıllı Arap yazar, gerçek adı Rûzbih bin Dâdûye idi.
